title: About the Author – Mohammed Nihal
excerpt: Who writes the skincare guides on youthfacebeauty.com, and how they are written.
content:
About the Author

Mohammed Nihal is the founder of Beauty Mart, a skincare business based in Azad Nagar, Bhatkal, Karnataka, and runs youthfacebeauty.com.

Every day he and the Beauty Mart team speak with customers from across India on WhatsApp about dark spots, uneven tone, sun tan and how to build a simple routine. The skincare guides on this site come from those real questions: what an ingredient does, how to use a cream safely, how to choose a product and how to avoid fake skincare.

What he writes about

  • Ingredients such as kojic acid, alpha arbutin, niacinamide and vitamin C
  • Simple morning and night routines for Indian skin and climate
  • How to compare skincare products and spot fakes
  • How to use Youth Face Beauty Cream carefully, with patch testing and sunscreen

An honest note

Mohammed is not a doctor or dermatologist. The guides are general cosmetic education and are not medical advice. For any persistent, painful, spreading or changing skin concern, please consult a qualified dermatologist. You can read how articles are prepared in our Editorial Policy.
